description: Compare two builds using the readonly builds/compare API (analytics:read; no SQL/admin access required). Returns P50/P95, sample/session counts and diffs. isRegression reports direction only, not a threshold breach or statistical certainty. Null metrics have an unknown cause; do not infer unsupported SDKs. Verify expected samples and ingestion readiness separately. Unfiltered comparisons include the whole build; map/platform filters change the population. A map filter excludes map_load events, so load_time_ms is unavailable under that filter. For an opt-in CI gate use framedash perf-diff --threshold <pct> --fail-on-regression.

fresh.description: Bypass the aggregation cache (default false); useful when checking newly ingested samples

map_id.description: Restrict to one spatial map_id; excludes map_load samples

name: compare_builds
title: Compare Builds
